brief:
Slovenia shifted its stance on Palestine following a United Nations General Assembly sideline meeting with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, Al Jazeera English reported. The country's policy changed sharply from its previous positions on the Israeli-Palestinian conflict.

Details of the discussions between Slovenian officials and Netanyahu remain unclear, though the timing of the policy change immediately after their encounter suggests the meeting played a decisive role in reshaping Slovenia's approach to the issue.
dek: Slovenia’s policy towards Palestine has changed sharply following a UNGA sideline meeting with Israeli PM Netanyahu.
title: Slovenia reverses Palestine policy after Netanyahu meeting
